description: Submit a video render job from a template. Returns a render ID — poll get_video_status until status is 'completed', then use the returned video URL as post media.

aspectRatio.description: Override aspect ratio (e.g. '9:16', '1:1'). Defaults to the template's ratio.

fields.description: Field values for the template, e.g. { quoteText: '...', backgroundColor: '#111' }. Field names come from the template definition.

name: create_video
